resources.string: Hands an induced skill draft to the structure gate: if it passes, the draft goes to the Drafts area for your approval — it is never promoted automatically and never written into the skill library. Rejections say exactly what is missing: no locator, no evidence, invalid structure, or an irreversible action. Every draft must point back to a teaching session that really happened, step by step.

Shows a 300-character summary of the latest teaching trace: step numbers, actions (click/type/select) and locator kinds only — no page text and no typed content; password and verification-code steps are dropped entirely. Read it before inducing a draft. Read-only.
